name: Sika Boom Cleaner
paste:
SIKA BOOM® CLEANER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika Boom® Cleaner, April 2023, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sika_boom_cleaner.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika Boom® Cleaner where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika Boom® Cleaner is an active cleaner for cleaning Sika Boom® application guns and fresh Sika Boom® residue from surfaces.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Clean Sika® PU foam application equipment after use.
    - Removes fresh, uncured polyurethane foam residue from equipment and other surfaces, as well as cleaning and removing grease from contaminated substrates.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika Boom® Cleaner
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Cleaner for Sika Boom® application guns
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 03.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very good PU foam cleaner
    - Very good PU spray gun and equipment cleaner
    - Integral valve for precise application
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Solvent-based cleaning agent
    - Colour: Transparent
    - Density: ~0.70 kg/l
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 500 ml pressurised container (can), 12 containers per box.
    - Shelf life: 18 months from the date of production. Must be used within 4 weeks.
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Store in an upright position. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 03.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - Sika Boom® Cleaner with integral spray head can be used to clean the PU foam application valves and application gun parts or to remove residues and from substrates. Spray Sika Boom® Cleaner directly onto the fresh foam and allow it to react for 5 - 10 seconds, then wipe-off the residue with a clean cloth.
    - Sika Boom® Cleaner without integral spray head can be used to rinse PU foam application guns. First remove cured PU foam residues mechanically. Then screw the Sika Boom® Cleaner container (can) onto the dispenser gun and press the trigger a few times to flush out all PU foam residue. After this cleaning, the dispenser gun can be stored attached to the Sika Boom® Cleaner container. Before removing the dispenser gun from the Sika Boom® Cleaner container, repeat this process several times.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Sika Boom® Cleaner can partly dissolve or discolour sensitive substrates (e.g. varnish, paint, plastics, textiles). We recommend testing the compatibility and colourfastness discretely on an unobtrusive small area before use.
    - Cured foam can only be removed mechanically.
    - Do not open Sika Boom® Cleaner using excess force
    - Do not incinerate Sika Boom® Cleaner container at any stage.
    - Do not spray Sika Boom® Cleaner towards open flames or onto hot objects.
    - Keep Sika Boom® Cleaner away from ignition sources and do not smoke when applying or close to Sika Boom® Cleaner.
    - Sika Boom® Cleaner may form explosive mixtures without adequate ventilation.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 03.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika Boom® Cleaner, April 2023, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sika_boom_cleaner.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika Boom®-Cleaner, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-sika-boom-cleaner.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
